title: Freedom 250 shared brain API for Katie's bots
purpose: A read-only, progressively disclosed projection of Katie's governed research library and analytical method for chats and invited agents.

excluded: private file contents not positively selected for publication

custody.research_catalog: Owns package identity, descriptive metadata and public organization.
custody.research_registry: Owns Workbench artifact membership and lifecycle.
custody.chronicle: Owns promoted truth and any vault copy after landing.
custody.public_api: Generated projection only; it does not supersede the governing owners.

retrieval_order: a material reading_url when public_full_text is true
a material data_url when access_state is public_machine_data
fresh primary-source verification when present state matters

evidence_rules: Preserve each source and package evidence cutoff, the package evidence_cutoff_note and each structured object data_as_of.
Separate fact, project inference, strongest ordinary rival, unresolved object and falsifier.
Prefer the controlling primary object over an announcement or summary.
Treat metadata-only material as an existence and routing signal, never as read content.
For public_machine_data, preserve the declared schema, vocabularies, scope boundary and upgrade or downgrade triggers.
control_boundaries: Distinguish actor, legal authority, product, technical capability, membership, transaction route, clearing, settlement, authoritative record, correction and remedy.
Do not turn a partnership, pilot, compatibility statement, product list or demonstration into proof of adoption or production operation.

answer_contract: Open package full_text_url rather than treating an index summary as the underlying research.
For public readings, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and use the structured object without discarding its evidence vocabulary or scope boundary.
A retrieval failure for public_full_text is a crawler or delivery issue, not private-by-design.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not claim the contents.
Name the packages and exact public pages or data objects used.
State package and material evidence cutoffs or as-of dates.
Verify time-sensitive claims against fresh primary sources.
Explain what would change the conclusion.
